title: Stored x-only leaf birthday search on secp256k1 at 125.707677: cross-node Chen-Stein success, executed leaf and transport kernels, priced hops

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39001 over the uniform challenge and fresh algorithm coins, with no heuristic: leaves of different nodes are independent uniform points, their class collisions are linear relations among independent generators, and the Chen-Stein method bounds P(no cross-node collision) within 2^-96.87 of e^-mu, mu = 0.494342942; drops, caps, rare values and defective batches are charged failure rows, RNDR as the ideal coin source adds none, and the bound is 0.3900100037 (section 6). On every run its total work is at most 2^125.707677 target-group-operation equivalents under classical-group-work-v2 (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit). Machine (section 2.1): 2^72 nodes in a 2^36 x 2^36 array, each with a main and a handler processor sharing a memory below 2^64 bytes with an explicit layout, and passive single-writer single-reader links to its row and column peers that end in 64-byte windows. Each node draws q1 = 108,966,605 points X = [b]Q + [a]P and 2^27 points Y = [c]P; its leaves are x(X+Y) and x(X-Y) for all q1 x 2^27 pairs (S = 2^126.699311), computed by batched inversion with one shared inverse per pair and keyed by min(x, beta x, beta^2 x). Records of 4 words take two hops (column, then row) to a home node, which groups them in d3 buckets and one stable d4 pass and scans adjacent keys. The per-record leaf, key, emit and handler-body work runs in the shipped kernels executed by kernels/a64.py: 105 + 523 + 53 per incidence and 83 per class-index product; each record hop is priced at 40, its executed protocol (17.5 and 29 instructions, event path included) plus a margin, the local pass at 20 (executed 9) and the scan at 7. certificate.py recomputes the ledger exactly: 502.9079 instructions per leaf, W = 2^125.7076768, and the claim is the least 6-decimal value at or above it. Peak memory 2^135.7542 bytes; preprocessing 2^111.0349 units, included; no advice. The bound is for the machine of section 2.1, in which only the two endpoints of a hop execute instructions for it. Kernel lineage: package 8f733826 (field rows, W2P, fe_inv, the F1 class row, a64.py); no prior acceptance or score is a premise. This is an analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Execute the leaf and transport kernels on production points and on a 4 x 4 machine with windows, event queues and flags against exact references, derive their instruction counts and compare them with certificate.py's constants, run the toy pipeline at q25 (multi-node grids near the production mu, single-pool controls, curve versus log-form equivalence), and run certificate.py. The class-rule checks and toy trials are budget-limited: each runs a stated minimum, then continues while its share of the remaining `seconds` lasts; the requested counts are caps. census-toy.json holds a longer off-runner run. This is not a production-scale attack; proof.md section 8 states the scope.
